notes: Prey hiding from Predators with chase mechanics, hiding spots and role swaps is the asymmetric 1 vs All case, and the school's hallways, classrooms and multiple escape routes are a looping warren whose P6 is what keeps a chase from ending in a cornered corridor. The answer to build the Big School first settles what would otherwise be a P4 question, so this is one map rather than a rotation; the mall, neighbourhood and optional maps are deferred and should be picked up as separate builds later. The rooftop access over the classroom floors puts walkable surfaces above walkable surfaces, which is what earns the P2. I dropped gate-escape because the timer swaps roles instead of ending the round, so nobody escapes anywhere, and the lockers, closets and dumpsters land as cover; the campfire forest main menu is a UI background, not a playable space, so it is not part of this build.
